title: Say What Hurts
summary: Recognize and produce The fèmal expressions for common aches, then use the reading to understand why Kintola does not go to school.

sketchBlocks.title: Vant fèmal, Tèt fèmal, Kou fèmal
sketchBlocks.bodyMarkdown:
Use **fèmal** with body words to talk about common aches:

- **Vant fèmal** — Stomach ache
- **Tèt fèmal** — Head ache
- **Kou fèmal** — Neck ache

Keep **fèmal** together as one word.

segments.text: with body words to talk about common aches

tryItExercises.title: Hear the stomach-ache expression
tryItExercises.prompt: Listen, then build the expression you hear.
tryItExercises.hint: The expression uses one body word followed by fèmal.

help.concept: Recognize a complete fèmal expression from audio.
help.hint_1: Listen for the body word first.
help.hint_2: Keep fèmal attached as one word.

sketchBlocks.title: Dan fèmal and Gòj fèmal
sketchBlocks.bodyMarkdown:
Add two more expressions:

- **Dan fèmal** — tooth ache
- **Gòj fèmal** — sorethroat

Here, **Dan** and **Gòj** are learned inside complete illness expressions.

segments.text: are learned inside complete illness expressions

sketchBlocks.title: Why Kintola Does Not Go to School
sketchBlocks.bodyMarkdown:
Read this short passage:

**Jodia Kintola pa ale lekòl, paske li gen tèt fèmal.**

Then ask:

**Poukisa Kintola pa ale lekòl jodia?**

The reason is already inside the reading:

**paske li gen tèt fèmal**

This reuses **Poukisa** from the first topic of this module and adds no new question form.
